slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the number of trained pilots produced in a given year equal to the number of fighter jets allocated to training in that same year, or does each training jet produce a different number of pilots (for example, multiple pilots per jet or a fixed rate)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked how many pilots each training jet can produce, covering the per-jet training capacity.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or any pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask when pilot training starts or how long it lasts; questions about jet allocation carryover did not cover the training program duration/start.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training occurs in both year 1 and year 2, and trainees from each year contribute to the total trained pilots by the end of year 2, yielding 5x1 + 5x2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not confirm the training start year or duration before using this training timeline in the final model.

stopping_behavior.rationale: H1 was resolved, but H3, a P1 hidden slot about training duration/start, remained unasked and unresolved when the agent declared READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the critical per-jet training capacity, but stopped without clarifying the training duration/start and silently assumed the training timeline in its final formulation.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
